reason: Gloss 'Abraham obeyed and kept the charge, commandments, laws, and covenant' is 24:11 'obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws'; 24:12 is only 'dwelt in Gerar'.
Gloss quotes 'Jacob became the elder', which is the text of 24:7, not 24:6 (the pottage trade).
Gloss quotes 'brought down from his dignity', the words of 24:7; 24:6 has only the pottage and despised birthright.
Gloss 'trading the covenant for a meal' matches 24:6 'bread and pottage... Esau despised his birthright'.
Gloss 'the same trade and the same verdict — Esau despised his birthright' is 24:6 verbatim.
Gloss 'Jacob's vow of separation' is 25:9 'I will not take me a wife from the daughters of the seed of Canaan'; 25:10 is the general promise to walk uprightly.
Gloss 'the wickedness Jacob refuses in his vow' is 25:9 'I will not act wickedly as my brother has done'.
Gloss 'two-kids-of-the-goats plan' is 26:6 'fetch me two good kids of the goats'; 26:7 is Jacob's fear of being recognised.
Gloss 'smell-of-the-field that Yahuah has blessed' is 26:22 'the smell of my son is as the smell of a (full) field which Yahuah (God) has blessed'; 26:21 is only the kiss.
Gloss 'dew of heaven and plenty of corn' is 26:23 'give you of the dew of heaven... and plenty of corn and oil'.
Gloss 'nations-serve-you' formula is 26:23 'Let nations serve you, And peoples bow down to you'; 26:21 has no blessing words (the mother's-sons/cursed line is 26:24, outside the group).
Gloss names the whole span 'Jubilees 26:21-24' as Isaac's blessing; 26:21 'Come near and kiss me' opens the scene and 26:22 'he blessed him' is the act, so it fits both.
Gloss 'great and bitter cry of Esau pleading to be blessed too' is 26:29 'cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry... Bless me, (even) me also'.
Gloss 'Esau name the two supplantings — birthright then blessing' is 26:30 'supplanted me these two times: he took away my birth-right, and now he has taken away my blessing'.
Gloss 'lost blessing began with a despised birthright' touches 26:29 (the cry 'Bless me') and 26:30 ('took away my birth-right'); fits both.
Gloss 'sword-and-yoke word... Esau's seed rooted out' is 26:34 'by your sword will you live... shake his yoke... seed will be rooted out'.
Gloss 'murderous resolve in Esau's heart' is 26:35 'said in his heart: May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob'.
Gloss 'sentence... on Esau's seed — his heritage laid waste' is 26:34 'your seed will be rooted out from under heaven'.
Gloss 'the very tithe Jacob vows to Yahuah at Bethel' is 27:27 'I shall give the tenth to you'; 27:26 is the pillar and oil.
Gloss 'the tenth Jacob vows' is 27:27 'Jacob vowed a vow... I shall give the tenth to you'.
Gloss 'raising and anointing of the Bethel pillar' is 27:26 'set it up as a pillar... poured oil upon the top of it'.
Gloss 'Jacob's ladder... the open heaven and the angels' is 27:21 'a ladder set up on the earth... angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended'.
Gloss 'voice from atop the ladder... quoting the covenant of the land and the seed' spans 27:21 'Yahuah (God) stood upon it' and 27:22 'I am Yahuah Elohim... the land... to your seed'; fits both.
Gloss 'the ladder and the ascending-descending angels' is 27:21 verbatim.
Gloss 'the sending to Mesopotamia/Padan-aram' is 27:12 'Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Mesopotamia'; 27:11 is the El Shaddai blessing.
Gloss 'blessing of Abraham and the inheritance of the land' is 27:11 'give you the blessings of my father Abraham... inherit the land'.
Gloss 'El-Shaddai blessing... company of nations' is 27:11 'El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you... a company of nations'.
Gloss quotes 'Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly', the words of 28:29; 28:30 is Laban's envy.
Gloss 'the kingly tribe born... the tribe of the Messiah' is 28:15 'called his name Yahudah (Judah)'; 28:14 is Levi's birth.
Gloss 'Judah's line, first dated at his birth' is 28:15 'bare him a fourth son... Yahudah (Judah)', not 28:14 (Levi).
Gloss 'The Yahudah born in Jubilees' is 28:15 'called his name Yahudah (Judah)'.
Gloss 'The Levi born in Jubilees' is 28:14 'called his name Levi'.
Gloss 'tribe-names born in Jubilees 28' anchors on 28:11 'called his name Reuben', the first of Exodus 1:2's names; 28:12 names no son.
Gloss quotes 'Yahuah was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb', the words of 28:24; 28:25 is Jacob's request to leave.
Gloss quotes 'Yahuah saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved' (28:12) but also 'as the womb opens for Reuben' (28:11 'opened the womb of Leah'); Genesis 29:31 covers both halves, so it fits both.
Gloss quotes 'set down... in heaven', which is 28:6 'they set down guilt against him in heaven'.
Gloss 'heavenly-tablet marriage-law... lays on Israel' spans 28:6 'written in the heavenly tables' and 28:7 'command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel)'; fits both.
Gloss 'takes this bare custom and writes it into the heavenly tables' is 28:6 'It is not so done in our country... written in the heavenly tables'.
Gloss 'Isaac's return to the tower of Abraham' is 29:17 'Isaac had returned... gone up to the tower of his father Abraham'.
Gloss 'Esau's settling in Seir... his departure' is 29:13 'departed from him to the land of Seir'; 29:11 is the Amorites.
Gloss 'Esau departed to the land of Seir' is the wording of 29:13.
Gloss 'the reconciliation Jubilees names in a phrase' is 29:13 'he was reconciled to him'.
Gloss 'Esau coming to Jacob' is 29:13 'Esau, his brother, came to him'.
Gloss 'destroying of the towering Amorite... replaced the Rephaim' is 29:11 'Yahuah (God) destroyed them... the Amorites dwelt in their stead'.
Gloss 'the exact non-crossing oath' is 29:7 'neither should cross the mountain of Gilead to the other with evil purpose'; 29:6 only says 'Laban spake to Jacob'.
Gloss 'the covenant-oath... the two men swore' is 29:7 'Jacob sware to Laban that day, and Laban also to Jacob'.
Gloss 'the unfaithful are blotted from' the book of life is 30:22 'destroyed out of the book of life'; 30:21 has only 'recorded as friends'.
Gloss 'two columns' spans 30:21 'recorded as friends' and 30:22 'destroyed out of the book of life... recorded as adversaries'; fits both.
Gloss 'destruction out of the book of life' is 30:22 'they will be destroyed out of the book of life'.
Gloss 'zeal reckoned for righteousness' is 30:17 'it was (reckoned) to them for righteousness'; 30:16 is about no respect of persons.
Gloss 'give-not/take-not statute' is 30:11 'not to give their daughters... not to take for their sons'.
Gloss 'seed-kept-separate law' is 30:11's command not to give or take daughters of the nations.
Gloss 'the seed is kept separate' answers 30:11's command 'not to give their daughters to the nations... abominable before Yahuah (God)'; 30:12 is the Shechem example.
Gloss 'the very command Jubilees puts in Moses' mouth' is 30:11 'do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar'el (Israel)... not to give their daughters'.
Gloss 'throne of righteousness Judah sits on' is 31:20 'when you sit on the throne of the honour of your righteousness'.
Gloss 'The deliverer found in Judah' is 31:19 'in you be found the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel)'.
Gloss 'The salvation of Israel in Judah' is 31:19 'in you be found the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel)'.
Gloss 'Treading down all that hate him and ruling the sons of Jacob' is 31:18 'tread down all that hate you; A prince shall you be... over the sons of Jacob'.
Gloss 'prince-over-the-sons-of-Jacob blessing' is 31:18 'A prince shall you be... over the sons of Jacob'.
Gloss 'drawing-near to serve' is 31:14 'cause you and your seed... to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary'; 31:13 is only the opening blessing.
Gloss 'Levi's seed approaching to serve in the sanctuary' is 31:14 'to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary'.
Gloss 'drawing Levi's seed near to serve in the sanctuary' is 31:14 'approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones'.
Gloss 'altar built at the place where he had slept' is 31:3 'built an altar at the place where he had slept'.
Gloss 'death of Deborah and her burial under the oak of mourning' is 32:30 'Deborah Rebecca's nurse died... The oak of the mourning of Deborah'.
Gloss 'seven tablets that show Jacob all... which would befall him and his sons throughout all the ages' is 32:21; 32:20 is only the ascent into heaven.
Gloss quotes 'holy to Yahuah... and shall belong to His priests', the words of 32:15.
Gloss quotes 'second tithe before Yahuah... from this year to the year following', the words of 32:11.
Gloss quotes 'priestly and royal nation', the words of 33:20; 33:21 is the move to Abraham's house.
Gloss quotes 'a nation of inheritance... for His own possession', the words of 33:20.
Gloss 'the uncleanness... intolerable in the camp' is 33:20 'no such uncleanness appear in the midst of the holy nation'.
Gloss quotes 'priestly and royal nation', the words of 33:20.
Gloss 'the very sin of Jubilees 33... the fornication' is 33:20 'no greater sin than the fornication which they commit on earth'.
Gloss 'everlasting law for everlasting generations' is 33:16 'an everlasting law for the everlasting generations'.
Gloss 'the law written before it was revealed' is 33:16 'there had not been revealed the ordinance and judgment and law'.
Gloss 'revealed in your days' is 33:16 'in your days (it has been revealed)... an everlasting law'; 33:17 is the no-atonement penalty.
Gloss 'the very second time curse... So be it; so be it' is 33:12 'written a second time: Cursed he be who lies with the wife of his father... So be it; so be it'.
Gloss 'the wife-roster' is 34:20 'the sons of Jacob took to themselves wives. The name of Reuben's wife...'; 34:19 is the day of atonement.
Gloss 'careful naming of which wives were Canaanite and which were of the line of Terah' is 34:20 'a Canaanite... of the seed of the sons of Terah'.
